notes.title: NEW NPC: Meet ISU-1
notes.content:
ISU-1 is the result of a new surveillance program launched by the G.A.T.E. (Greater American Technological Empire). Its purpose is to ensure more flexible monitoring at a lower cost. Equipped with multiple cameras, ISU-1 patrols streets and building halls to make sure that “everything is in order.”


[list]
[*] This autonomous unit reacts to your presence.
[*] Your behavior around it may influence your loyalty rating.
[*] Comply, and your dedication to the Empire will be noted.
[*] Avoid, tamper, or act suspiciously, and your behavior may be… re-evaluated.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rkEN3Mp.jpg[/img]

In certain situations, you may need to avoid detection to achieve specific objectives.
Remember: ISU-1 is always watching—so the Empire doesn’t have to.
